lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: Minh, the director wants to bring forward the training plan. Can you finish it by Wednesday?

lines.speaker: Minh (HR Executive)
lines.text: Wednesday? I thought the deadline was next Monday.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: It was, but the budget meeting moved to Thursday. So Wednesday is a firm deadline now.

lines.speaker: Minh (HR Executive)
lines.text: I understand. But I'm still waiting for data from three departments.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: What can you finish by Wednesday, realistically?

lines.speaker: Minh (HR Executive)
lines.text: I can do the schedule and the cost part. The course details need more time.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: The director mainly needs the costs for the budget meeting.

lines.speaker: Minh (HR Executive)
lines.text: Then as a compromise, I can do a partial delivery on Wednesday and send the full plan on Friday.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: That works. Do you need an extra hand to chase the departments?

lines.speaker: Minh (HR Executive)
lines.text: Yes, please. If Linh can call them today, I'll get the data by close of business.

options: The budget meeting moved to Thursday

questions.q: What will Minh deliver on Wednesday?

options: She will write the course details
She will join the budget meeting
She will call the departments for data
